# Chapter14 / ART-22 finite publication contract

## Ownership and non-goals

Layer A owns four complete canonical documents, eight supplied validation records, two scalar criteria per question, direct IDs/revisions/evidence, six Results, four Methods, stop/disposition/cleanup/residual semantics, Case/JSON leaf parity, parent boundaries and Source/route/index selection. Shared Publication Projection1.1.0 owns all Markdown/Kramdown/HTML/URL interpretation; shared Policy1.2.0 owns safety grammar. There is no chapter-owned renderer, URL parser or operation interpreter.

All observations, times, stops, cleanup/residual evidence and decisions are authored synthetic records. The evaluator compares two nonempty ID strings to separately frozen expected IDs; missing is null, not false. It does not execute a real replay, Policy engine, network operation, Account creation, cleanup or residual measurement. No actual product behavior, safety, NIST/OWASP conformance or execution authority is inferred.

The six Results are Supported / Partially supported / Weakened / Inconclusive / Rejected / Stopped. Not performed is an execution disposition, never a seventh Result. The four Methods are Static / Simulation / Offline replay / Minimal synthetic operation; the last remains planned and unperformed. A stop trigger takes precedence, then nonperformance, then the finite two-criterion comparison. Supported may remain Open; Inconclusive may be a Complete reading record if gaps, owner, deadline, cleanup and residual records are present. Complete is not successful remediation.

## Finite regression ownership

- Eight canonical records and every Result/Method; all nine supported/refuted/missing outcome pairs, stop priority and Not performed precedence.
- Expectation/validation/subject/revision/criterion bindings, typed nonempty scalar values, empty/unknown input rejection. The kernel expects shaped records; the model owner additionally enforces observation presence/basis/time and no observations for unperformed operations.
- Frozen authored observations/questions/claim ceilings and separate expected values. A joint rewrite can make a raw comparison agree but is rejected as a change to the supplied input contract.
- Every supplied object rejects missing/extra keys; every leaf rejects a wrong type and unsafe string. This traverses one fixed document, not an unbounded fuzz grammar. Schema identity is pinned separately, including the closed-object rules.
- Every Case table row is compared to its JSON leaf. Empty arrays are literal inline code in Markdown, not undefined link references.
- Source9/10/14 consumers retain complete previous notes plus the new scoped adoption. Missing previous or new scope, wrong sections and wrong Note path fail in all owning consumers.
- Preamble/body/tail selection, explicit prohibition counterpart, finite section inventory, required semantic fields, shared unsupported PP1001, full Source token ownership and four explanation blocks before the command.
- Exact provenance identity/cardinality/heading/owner; moved, changed, duplicate and missing identities fail with actionable diagnostics.
- Strict JSON duplicate keys/nonstandard numbers/UTF-8, fixed regular input inventory, static symlink, FIFO, size, missing platform primitive and unknown path rejection. Linux/WSL2 is required; this is not a concurrent hostile-filesystem sandbox.

## Exact reviewed provenance

Eleven host relations cover official/delegated source destinations, the local checker path and non-host version/section identifiers. Seven analytic relations are nonoperative boundary, explicit prohibition or limited evidence/cleanup statements. All seventeen distinct typed identities were individually read by the author; one is in both categories. This is not an independent review claim.

Exemptions are exact document/type/element/attribute/text/heading and singleton cardinality; destination exemptions include their visible owner. No domain-wide, extension, version, secret, negative-word or future finding bypass exists. A new or actionable field does not inherit an exception. Parent content and the shared scanner/renderer are unchanged.

## Delivery gates

Run `python3 scripts/check_chapter14_contract.py` with `PYTHONHASHSEED=0,1,7,42`. Run the single shared pinned-renderer corpus separately. Actual prepublication negative tests, exact-head full QA/CI, deterministic generation and canonical drift, links/assets, desktop/mobile and independent PR review remain separate gates; passing unit tests is not their substitute.

The parent Chapter8 eight states including Running, Chapter9 Draft/expired authority/original window/three objects/false, independent CASE11, Chapter12 Unknown/non-Federation three-null distinction and Chapter13 authored Verified/no real build/deploy/signature validation are digest-pinned. Prior chapter preflight lists and Source notes are updated only for this new consumer, not to change their semantic contracts. Formatter and dependency pins remain unchanged.
